review_locator: PMCID:PMC3544778, Laminin-511: A multi-functional adhesion protein; PMID:16546822, Review: Lutheran/B-CAM: a laminin receptor on red blood cells and in various tissues
primary_title: The LG1-3 tandem of laminin alpha5 harbors the binding sites of Lutheran/basal cell adhesion molecule and alpha3beta1/alpha6beta1 integrins
decision_basis: The reviews identify Lutheran/B-CAM as a receptor for laminin alpha5 and cite the primary recombinant laminin study that maps the Lu/B-CAM-binding site within the properly assembled alpha5 LG1-3 and coiled-coil context.
limitations_preserved: Binding-only edge; preserve BCAM/Lu nomenclature, laminin-511/521/523 alpha5-chain composition, and requirement for correctly assembled alpha5 LG1-3/coiled-coil structure; no downstream relay or SCI inference.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC3544778, Laminin-511: A multi-functional adhesion protein; PMCID:PMC11260871, Polymerizing laminins in development, health, and disease
primary_title: Molecular dissection of the alpha-dystroglycan- and integrin-binding sites within the globular domain of human laminin-10
decision_basis: The reviews identify alpha-dystroglycan as a laminin LG-domain receptor and cite the primary laminin-10 deletion/mutagenesis study showing alpha-dystroglycan binding through LG4, distinct from integrin-binding LG3.
limitations_preserved: Binding-only edge; preserve laminin-10=laminin-511 composition, alpha-dystroglycan glycosylation dependence, and LG4-domain specificity; no beta-dystroglycan cytoskeletal relay or SCI inference.
